prompt:
Create ONE finished NATIVE EDITABLE SVG sheet: FOUR DISTINCT ACTION KEY POSES of the SAME Cinder acolyte in the SAME south-east/front-quarter view for Emberwake, a sculptural dark-fantasy tactical action RPG. These are future visual concepts, not new combat rules. A ranged attack currently releases immediately and then cools down; do not imply a charged spell mechanic or prescribed frame timing. The study must extend the supplied design, not invent a new creature. Native vector paths, never embedded raster.

CHARACTER: dusty wine/salmon hooded adult, ash-gray face recessed within deep hood, angular overlapping mantle, narrow ivory stitch strip on anatomical LEFT shoulder, plain dark belt, uneven split robe hem, two soot-dark planted boots. Anatomical RIGHT hand grips one bent dark wooden crook staff with ONE ivory collar, screen-left as in source. Anatomical LEFT hand, screen-right, performs the cast gesture. One long asymmetric sleeve, other closer fitting. Small warm ochre ember only, close to hand/body; no beam, flying projectile, ring, halo, spark shower, flame mantle, large VFX or persistent trail. No armor, new equipment or jewelry. Preserve palette exactly: wine #753f49, dusty salmon #b3726b, lit cloth #d99886, shadow #432d39, ash face #a6a09a, staff #604b3f, ivory #e5d5af, ember #efb56c. Upper-left SCREEN light in every pose, three broad readable value groups, organic painted/cut-paper fantasy sculpture. Quiet broad cloth, no photoreal PBR or tiny ornamental noise.

CONTINUITY: source SVG appended below as TEXT, not an image input or image edit. It is the repaired approved-for-study SE directional candidate. Keep its hood size, garment construction, gear, face direction, hand ownership and silhouette family. Evolve the pose, not the design. Retain one fixed mildly elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC camera looking down27degrees, square screen-aligned game view, character facing lower-right. No frontal turn or side-view cutaway. Shoulders/hips show front and rightward side depth. Across four poses head, staff and planted feet retain their scale; both boots and staff tip keep common ground/root anchors. The main changing contour is the left arm, shoulder compression and slight torso lean, with limited answering cloth. Do not mirror a group. Avoid duplicate body/arm outlines with only moved embers.

CONNECTED ANATOMY FIRST: begin each figure with a SOLID continuous torso garment from shoulder mantle through waist/belt and hips. No transparent slit or floating waist between mantle and belt. Fit shoulder/elbow/wrist as connected curved cloth volumes. Raised left sleeve must attach to shoulder, left hand emerge from cuff, right hand visibly grip staff. Mantle lies over torso, belt wraps around solid waist, robe overlaps boots. No detached palm, dislocated forearm or staff through cloth. Show support and coherent body mass even where sleeve folds hide joints.

FOUR POSES (read clearly at actual32-40px, not only enlarged):
1 PREPARATION: left elbow gathered tightly toward sternum, forearm angled up/in, cupped palm and tiny ember near upper ribs; shoulders slightly compressed, hood inclined forward, weight settling into bent forward knee. Left sleeve forms a short folded triangle, elbow contour close to body. This is an anticipation concept only, no measured delay.
2 RELEASE: left shoulder opens and elbow extends DOWN-RIGHT toward target; palm turned outward and fingers grouped, reach makes a clear outward arm silhouette without making figure too wide. Hand ends around lower-chest height, not overhead. NO projectile or long spell trail; one tiny ember at palm is enough. Upper body reaches a little over planted forward boot; right hand keeps staff planted and load-bearing. Distinct straight/extended versus gathered gesture.
3 FOLLOW-THROUGH: left elbow folds down, forearm sweeps ACROSS THE WAIST toward center, palm pronated/down and quiet; long sleeve falls below forearm. Shoulder follows momentum forward/down, head still faces lower-right, torso leans slightly more than recovery. Broad elbow/sleeve contour is lower than release and noticeably different. NO extra orb painted across body or disconnected sleeve. Ember may be absent after release. Foot anchors fixed, no running.
4 RECOVERY: torso and hood rise back to alert guard, left elbow LOW by hip with forearm bent upward only to lower ribs, relaxed palm close to body, tiny ember reappears near low hand if useful. Mantle settles, left sleeve hangs close to thigh. Clearly lower hand and taller posture than preparation, less forward lean than follow-through. Same weapon, boots and proportions. This is a quiet reusable exit pose, not a second attack.

SHEET/EXTRACTION: exact root width1536 height768 viewBox="0 0 1536 768". Two columns/two rows, each cell768x384, with centered384x384 square workspaces. Exactly FOUR outer groups: id="cultist-se-preparation" transform="translate(192 0)"; id="cultist-se-release" transform="translate(960 0)"; id="cultist-se-follow-through" transform="translate(192 384)"; id="cultist-se-recovery" transform="translate(960 384)". All geometry inside each group uses LOCAL0..384coordinates. Keep each full figure including staff within x=32..346,y=22..356, approximately visible280-310wide and320-330tall, so0.1scale reads28-31x32-33px. All figures same scale; DO NOT enlarge release to show detail. Same boot contacts roughly y340and350, staff tipy348. No figure outside workspace. All unused space fully TRANSPARENT. No background rectangle, terrain, floor, diamond base, shadow, frame, label, arrow, text, logo or watermark. No scripts, external resources, image/use, filters, gradients, animation or paint-resource IDs. Simple explicit filled vector paths, restrained strokes; only outergroupIDs for extraction. NativeSVG only, noGIF.

Judge the four genuine gesture changes, connected waist/arms and true32px readability before details. Preserve the current character's distinctive hood/mantle/staff/ember, but give it a useful and coherent action vocabulary. Do not substitute four static turnaround copies.
